creativity.reason: Level 0: the business description covers only CDMO pharmaceutical development and manufacturing, and 'design' refers to drug and process engineering (a trap), so there is no creative activity.

community.reason: Level 2: all documented activities are employee development (Learn@Lonza, talent marketplace, development plans with more than 68% coverage), so the score is capped at 2; 'supporting our communities' is general language only.

cross_cultural.reason: Level 2: specific current internal practices (transgender and non-disclosure gender self-identification, an operational roadmap to remove participation barriers) without reach figures; the nationality and gender statistics are demographics only.

entrepreneurship.reason: Level 1: the report shows start-ups only as customers or partners, with no named enabling program aimed at barriers to founding or growing a business.

ai.notes: Health Care CDMO. The Capsules & Health Ingredients business is classified as discontinued (sale signed March 2026, closing expected H2 2026), and the Personalized Medicine and MODA software businesses are being divested. The people data includes CHI colleagues. The report points to a separate 2025 Sustainability Report for more detail, but the annual report itself describes specific people activities, so coverage is sufficient. Gender equality ESG bonus objective paid out at 0% (female management share only maintained). 'Design2Optimize' and 'complex molecule design' are chemistry/engineering design (creativity trap). Board member Roger Nitsch's 'entrepreneurial activities' and the Vice-Chair role of a director at the LA Philharmonic are personal, not company activities. Joining CMAC and supplier ESG engagement are industry/supply-chain activities, not external education or community investment. Implied total: 0 + 12 + 8 + 3 = 23/100.
